title: The middle of nowhere: the places on Earth farthest from any town
excerpt: I measured how far every point on land is from the nearest town of 1,000 people. A quarter of the land outside Antarctica is more than 100 km from one; the most landlocked place on Earth is just 65 km from one; and Britain's middle of nowhere is near Cape Wrath.
seo_description: How far is every point on land from a town? 25% of land is over 100 km from one. The most remote places on each continent, in every country and in Britain.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The middle of nowhere' in black and red on pale paper, beside a world map coloured by distance to the nearest town: pale cream across Europe, India and China, orange and red over the Sahara, Siberia, Canada and Australia, and dark purple over Greenland and Antarctica.
